book_cn: 外研社版选择性必修第三册
unit_cn: Unit 4 Artificial Intelligence: A Real Threat? 人工智能:真威胁?
source: 外研社(新标准)选择性必修第三册 Unit 4 词表(p38-47 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、人工智能/技术主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: Artificial machines can now learn from huge amounts of data.
words.example_cn: 人造的机器现在能从海量数据中学习。

words.example_en: Artificial intelligence may be our greatest achievement so far.
words.example_cn: 人工智能也许是我们迄今为止最大的成就。

words.example_en: Some people fear that machine intelligence may one day match human intelligence.
words.example_cn: 有人担心机器智能有一天会赶上人类智能。

words.example_en: Hawking warned that AI could be the worst thing ever for humanity.
words.example_cn: 霍金警告说,人工智能可能是人类有史以来最糟糕的东西。

words.example_en: My phone has a smart assistant that answers any question at once.
words.example_cn: 我的手机里有一个聪明的助手,能立刻回答任何问题。

words.meaning_cn: 易受影响的;易受……伤害的
words.example_en: Unlike humans, self-driving cars are not susceptible to tiredness.
words.example_cn: 与人类不同,自动驾驶汽车不会受疲劳影响。

words.example_en: Taxi drivers could be among the first victims of automation.
words.example_cn: 出租车司机可能是自动化最早的受害者之一。

words.example_en: Nearly every job is potentially at risk in the long run.
words.example_cn: 从长远看,几乎每一份工作都可能面临风险。

words.example_en: Half of these jobs may disappear because of automation.
words.example_cn: 这些工作中有一半可能因自动化而消失。

words.example_en: Much of the value of AI lies in its capacity to analyse data.
words.example_cn: 人工智能的价值大多在于它分析数据的能力。

words.example_en: AI can analyse vast amounts of data in just a few seconds.
words.example_cn: 人工智能能在短短几秒内分析海量数据。

words.example_en: Super-intelligent AI could be the biggest leap forward in history.
words.example_cn: 超级智能的人工智能可能是历史上最大的飞跃。

words.example_en: We have no choice but to embrace AI and regulate it.
words.example_cn: 我们别无选择,只能接纳人工智能并对它加以管理。

words.example_en: Saying "My AI did it" is no excuse for illegal behaviour.
words.example_cn: 说一句"是我的AI干的"不能成为违法行为的借口。

words.example_en: Blaming a machine cannot make immoral actions acceptable.
words.example_cn: 把责任推给机器并不能让不道德的行为变得可以接受。

words.example_en: A large number of clients have been attracted to genetic testing.
words.example_cn: 大量客户被基因检测所吸引。

words.example_en: The website cited one company that compared the talents of twins.
words.example_cn: 该网站举出一家比较双胞胎天赋的公司为例。

words.example_en: Bobby was assessed, and his talents were found to be mostly scientific.
words.example_cn: 鲍比接受了评测,他的天赋被发现主要在科学方面。

words.example_en: I reckon that robot doctors are just around the corner.
words.example_cn: 我认为机器人医生很快就会出现。

words.example_en: Tiny robots may one day remove cancerous cells from the body.
words.example_cn: 微型机器人有朝一日也许能清除体内的癌细胞。

words.example_en: Companies plan to meet the growing demand for faster transport.
words.example_cn: 各公司计划满足人们对更快捷交通日益增长的需求。

words.example_en: Many cities already have elevated cycle paths above the streets.
words.example_cn: 许多城市的街道上方已经建有高架自行车道。

words.example_en: His father said Robutt was only a mechanical imitation of a dog.
words.example_cn: 他父亲说罗巴特只是一只狗的机械仿制品。

words.example_en: Jimmy refused to believe his robot dog was just an imitation.
words.example_cn: 吉米不肯相信他的机器狗只是个仿制品。

words.example_en: Jimmy began to frown when his father called Robutt a machine.
words.example_cn: 当父亲把罗巴特称作机器时,吉米皱起了眉头。

words.example_en: Jimmy held the little robot dog tightly in his arms.
words.example_cn: 吉米把那只小机器狗紧紧抱在怀里。

words.example_en: The desperate look on his face meant he would not change his mind.
words.example_cn: 他脸上拼命的神情表明他不会改变主意。

words.example_en: Foreshadowing gives the reader a clue about what will happen next.
words.example_cn: 伏笔给读者提供了接下来会发生什么的线索。

words.example_en: The news report blamed faulty robotics for the prison breakout.
words.example_cn: 这则新闻把越狱事件归咎于有故障的机器人系统。

words.example_en: Check whether the language style of your story stays consistent.
words.example_cn: 检查一下你的故事语言风格是否保持一致。

words.example_en: On the Moon, Jimmy's arms and legs were long and agile.
words.example_cn: 在月球上,吉米的胳膊和腿又长又灵活。

words.example_en: The outer side of the crater began to slope southward.
words.example_cn: 环形山的外侧开始向南倾斜。

words.example_en: Jimmy raced up the slope in a light, floating hop.
words.example_cn: 吉米以轻盈飘浮的跳跃冲上斜坡。

words.example_en: The robot dog would squeak whenever Jimmy came near.
words.example_cn: 每当吉米靠近,那只机器狗就会发出吱吱声。

words.example_en: Robutt had four legs and tendons of steel.
words.example_cn: 罗巴特有四条腿和钢铁般的肌腱。

words.example_en: Jimmy heard his father's voice on his private wavelength.
words.example_cn: 吉米在自己的私人频道上听到了父亲的声音。

words.example_en: Jimmy was playing out on the crater with his robot dog.
words.example_cn: 吉米正和他的机器狗在环形山上玩耍。

words.example_en: Old robots were bound to break down sooner or later.
words.example_cn: 旧机器人迟早一定会出故障。

words.example_en: AI doctors are on the horizon, even if they are not here yet.
words.example_cn: 人工智能医生即将到来,尽管它们还未出现。

words.example_en: He called the robot dog a robot-mutt, and that was how it got its name.
words.example_cn: 他把这只机器狗叫作"机器杂种狗",名字就是这么来的。

words.example_en: Robutt had a simple positronic brain inside its metal body.
words.example_cn: 罗巴特的金属身体里有一个简单的正电子大脑。

words.example_en: Every recommendation the assistant makes seems to suit me.
words.example_cn: 这个助手给出的每一条推荐似乎都很适合我。

words.example_en: Self-driving cars can make judgements based on the information they collect.
words.example_cn: 自动驾驶汽车能根据收集到的信息作出判断。

words.example_en: A truly independent AI could think without any programming.
words.example_cn: 真正独立的人工智能不需要任何编程就能思考。

words.example_en: We may have to embrace AI rather than fear it.
words.example_cn: 我们也许必须欣然接受人工智能,而不是惧怕它。

words.example_en: I would not bank on patients trusting a robot doctor soon.
words.example_cn: 我不会指望病人很快就会信任机器人医生。
